title: A Bavarian servant to his duke, and a report on the Pressburg talks, c. 1533-34, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 ff.262-263 (DECODE R9416; catalogue 161)

steps.what: Web search for KAA 4591 and Augurelio ciphers
DECODE record list from the API dump (141 records in the volume); images of the 14 targets and 30 neighbouring keys fetched with the cookie
R9416 f.262 gloss transcribed (read at the time)

R9416 f.263 recto lines 11-16 re-keyed by hand from the v2 transcription and checked word by word on the image: v2 sign z split into e (one-bar zig-zag) and s (two-bar dagger), b into d and l; lines 11-12 agree with the faint contemporary gloss ('das aus den tag zu bresburg erfolgt ist dahin auch / des Ferd tail ... mit grossem bumbb kummen sint auch'). Normalised passage (Pressburg diet, 'mit grossem Pomp', full powers, the Turkish embassy on Shrove Tuesday) in r9416/reading_p3_11-16.txt; rest of f.263 not yet re-keyed.

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from kaa4591 (catalogue 161), whose fourteen records are letters in at least six systems: System A′ stays in kaa4591; Łaski's System B is kaa4591b; R9325 is fulda1576; R9367, R9416, R9424 and R9319 are r9367, r9416, r9424 and r9319; R9291 is a key fragment. R9416 keeps outcome.parts: f.262 and f.263 are two sign sets in one record.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 199 tokens, 25 types, de-1500s order 4: reading -2.667 per letter; polyphonic: 13% of read tokens differ from their type's commonest value. Verdict: not applicable.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): f.263: v2 transcription, solver decrypt and the hand-keyed lines 11-16; f.262: the contemporary gloss only, its cipher signs are not transcribed (missing)

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): gloss.txt (f. 262) read: page B builds, page A does not; relabelled decoded, not read. The f. 263 entry is read only on recto ll. 11-16, which is what fraction_read 0.06 counts; excerpt note added. Claim unchanged.

Re-read (REREAD_BRIEF, batch b32): DECODE R9416 fetched logged in (4 images, no attachment); f. 262 pages turned, deskewed and cut into one full-resolution crop per cipher line, with the faint gloss in the same crop.

f. 262 key rebuilt letter for letter from the contemporary interlinear decipherment of page B (B01-B07 aligned sign by sign): simple substitution with homophones (a, e, u, b) and code signs; # = ss (dermassen, diß), ƛ = n (dan), x = i found on page A; X, ⊼ and a G-sign unidentified (r9416/f262_key.md).

f. 262 page A read from its signs, all 25 lines including the unglossed A09-A11 (Minckwitz, Silesia, the Italian and Spanish foot); six gloss misreadings corrected from the figures; page B from the decipherment. r9416/f262_reading.md and _en.md; score 0.852 (23/27) on explicit holes, 0.444 plain; look-alike letters ~2%. Relabelled read (grade B).

Verify sweep (reading audit v2): f. 262 (both pages, 40 cipher lines) transcribed sign by sign from IMG_R9416_I44531_P1/P2 in full-resolution strips (r9416/f262_signs.txt, 1,498 signs) and re-decoded with the f262 key (research/reading_audit/v2_r9416_f262_dec.py). Word-by-word alignment with f262_reading.md changed 17 words to the signs' reading (A02 zuziehen, A03 unter, A07 bot, A08 'es sein solt', A10 polen, A12 italische, A18 wolt, A21 gestolen, A23 verner, A24 mag, B05 guldin, B14 unterteniglich ...) and added the code signs the gloss skips (B09 [G], B12 [X]) and 'her' (B12). Reading body 0.852 -> 0.963 on explicit holes (0.481 plain). Kept read, grade B.

r2h: the f. 262 key (rebuilt from that leaf's contemporary decipherment) tried on f. 263. The two leaves were compared on the full-resolution DECODE images: different sign sets (f. 262 figure-eight g, ♀/9 e, triangle d; f. 263 open-square n, daggers, io, triangle f). The f. 262 key gives nothing on f. 263.

r2h: DECODE images P3/P4 (3468 x 4624, the record's full resolution; no attachment or comment on R9416) cut into per-line crops, turned 180 deg. A faint contemporary interlinear decipherment stands over recto lines 1-12 and the last verso lines, not only the first two lines; transcribed as far as legible (r9416/f263_gloss.txt). It writes fg over the hourglass X, Khö over the barred T, Ferd over g.

r2h: f. 263 read line by line (recto 39 + verso 43 lines) from the v2 labels decoded with the extended hand key (r9416/f263_key.md; research/reading_audit/r2h_dec263.py), each line checked on its crop: K serves k and b (the old 'Kreekurg/Krakau' is Bresburg, r22/r24/v36), θ = d/t, Y = ll; 'mit vij scheffe', 'Emrich Besche', 'widisch lannt, welches doch nit sein ist', Gritti dispatched, an article for the King's allies in [Ω]'s instruction, commissioners recalled from Pressburg; last line 'datm ofen den 12 marcij' (Buda, 12 March). r9416/f263_reading.md, f263_en.md, f263_reread_log.md.

r2h: v2_score.py on the reading body: plain 0.465 (33/71), explicit holes 0.775 (55/71). Look-alike count (research/reading_audit/r2h_lookalike263.py, reading aligned word by word with the decode): 117 of 2,738 letters (4.2%) on the second value of a multi-valued sign (z e/s 43, b d/l 35, p b/w 21, dagger o/s 8, o/e 6, K k/b 3), 108 (3.9%) outside the glossed lines; image spot checks do not separate the e and s daggers consistently. Above the 3% limit: f. 263 beyond ll. 11-16 kept decoded, not read; fraction_read 0.352 -> 0.353 (measured counts).

texts.label: f.263 (pp. 3-4), report on the Pressburg talks, c. 1533-34
texts.summary: A Bavarian agent's report on the Pressburg negotiations between 'beden kunigen' (Ferdinand and John Zápolya), a Turkish embassy, Imre Czibak's offer of tribute to the Sultan and Alvise Gritti's dispatch, so c. 1533-34. Broken ciphertext-only by constrained annealing: decrypt_f263.txt is the solver's working decrypt of the whole leaf (local errors, before the look-alike split); recto lines 11-16 are re-keyed by hand and checked on the image (reading_p3_11-16.txt).
texts.note: Excerpt only: recto lines 11-16 are counted as read (reading_p3_11-16.txt, 199 of 3,313 codes). 23 Oct 2026 (r2h): the whole leaf now has a partial reading, r9416/f263_reading.md (English f263_en.md; key f263_key.md; log f263_reread_log.md), every line checked on the full-resolution image, with the faint contemporary gloss over recto 1-12 and the last verso lines transcribed (f263_gloss.txt; it names three codes: fg = E. F. G., Khö = the King, Ferd). Explicit-hole share 0.775 (55/71), plain 0.465, but 117 of 2,738 letters (4.2%; 3.9% outside the glossed lines) rest on the second value of a multi-valued sign chosen by the word (b d/l, z e/s, p b/w, K k/b), above the 3% look-alike limit with no contemporary text to confirm them: the leaf beyond lines 11-16 stays decoded, not read. The report is dated in its last line: Datum Ofen (Buda), 12 March.

texts.label: f.262 (pp. 1-2), servant's letter to his duke, 'eritags nach Jacobi'
texts.summary: A Bavarian servant to his duke, Tuesday after St James (c. 1533-34): he could not get through Austria and Styria, where troops are quartered everywhere and a messenger was struck down, nor through Silesia and Poland because of Minckwitz and other dangers; Italian and Spanish foot are to move through Styria and down the Danube into Hungary; the duke should have sent Bartlen von Eschlkam; four thousand Turks are said to be out under cover of an embassy, sparing neither friend nor foe; he means to travel on, pursue dealings begun through a lord, claim seven years' pension, and asks for fifty gulden as Oberrichter at Straubing. Page A read from its signs with the key rebuilt from the contemporary gloss of page B; page B follows the gloss.

reading_review.note: r9416/f262_reading.md: page A (25 lines, including the three unglossed A09-A11) read sign by sign on the full-resolution DECODE image with the key rebuilt letter for letter from the contemporary interlinear decipherment of page B (r9416/f262_key.md; B01-B07 checked against the signs); page B follows that decipherment. The signs correct the earlier gloss transcription in six places (A03, A13, A16, A18, A19, A22). Reading body 0.852 (23/27) on explicit holes with code signs counted as holes, 0.444 plain (early New High German spelling). Look-alike letters about 2% (the w/b/p and u/o shape families, read by sense). Open: codes X, ⊼ and a G-sign, and eight bracketed words. Verified 23 Oct 2026 (reading audit v2): f. 262 transcribed sign by sign (r9416/f262_signs.txt, 1,498 signs, both pages) and re-decoded with f262_key.md (research/reading_audit/v2_r9416_f262_dec.py); the decode was aligned word by word with the reading and 17 words changed to what the signs give (zuziehen, unter, bot, 'es sein solt' for 'es lern solt', polen, italische, wolt, gestolen, verner for an unread word, mag for [?wag], guldin, unterteniglich ...; two code signs and 'her' the gloss skipped added in B09/B12; [?gefallen], [?dinst] bracketed). Reading body now 0.963 (26/27) on explicit holes, 0.481 plain; before 0.852 / 0.444.
